messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "digoxin needs care for two separate reasons"
set: ["digoxin needs care for two separate reasons", "needs care in people with breathing problems", "effective contraception for two weeks after final dose", "dose needs may be different during pregnancy", "two weeks before conception and through first trimester", "taking more thyroid hormone than your body needs can cause an overactive thyroid", "monitor for fluid buildup", "risk for overdose and death", "not intended for as-needed pain relief", "not studied for long-term use in anxiety", "not an approved indication for diabetic nephropathy", "no recognized potential for dependence or abuse", "not a fast-acting rescue medicine for asthma attacks", "higher risk for people allergic to other opioids", "see the 'Warnings - Boxed Warning' for more details", "need to consult doctor for long-term treatment and vitamin B-12 concerns"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
